question: If one NSSTS program fails, what else breaks, and what are the warning signs?
answer: The package traces 18 failure chains; the widest (“A transformer factory delay, failed FITT field test, or unaccepted transformer delivery constrains a major project interconnection”) reaches 5 sectors. 15 of the 18 are rated high immediacy, and 2 are past their re-check date with no newer check.

sections.title: How far each failure reaches
sections.sub: Number of sectors each chain reaches, in the package's reach order (#1 widest).

rows.label: #3 two wave active secure cloud reach
#4 two wave launch and network reach

sections.title: Chain by chain, with the warning signs
sections.sub: Each card starts with what would set the chain off; the warning signs are printed on the face.

items.title: #1 · Four wave infrastructure reach
items.sub: 5 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: A transformer factory delay, failed FITT field test, or unaccepted transformer delivery constrains a major project interconnection.
kv: factory completion or commissioning slip; failed or delayed FITT utility field acceptance; absence of a named project customer or accepted delivery; interconnection or energization milestone delay
Power or interconnection readiness could delay compute-center, fab, biomanufacturing, nuclear or secure-cloud commissioning even where the downstream equipment is otherwise ready.
Multiple transformer OEMs, phased load, spare inventory and alternate interconnection designs provide partial redundancy, subject to voltage class and qualification.
Energy systems, grid and nuclear infrastructure; AI, secure compute and platform; Semiconductors and microelectronics; Biotechnology and biomanufacturing; Information management and cybersecurity
What the record does not prove

The transformer awards and projects are direct evidence; the registries do not establish that any named transformer company supplies any named downstream AI center, fab, bioplant or cloud site, and the downstream edge IDs are exposure markers rather than bill-of-material links.

items.title: #2 · Three sector operational network reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: PWSA ground-segment interoperability, network-management acceptance, or Type 1 cryptography qualification fails or slips.
kv: Tranche 1 checkout or mesh-acceptance delay; GDMS ground-integration milestone rejection; Type 1 certification delay; absence of follow-on ground or cryptography orders
Launched or delivered spacecraft could remain below operational-network acceptance, and later tracking or custody layers could slip despite successful spacecraft production.
Staged tranche checkout, alternate cryptographic implementations, multiple ground nodes and fault isolation can reduce a single integration failure's reach.
Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing; Communications and networking; Information management and cybersecurity
What the record does not prove

Contracts and the cryptography SBIR are direct, but no source shows that Forward Edge AI currently encrypts York, L3Harris, Sierra or Millennium spacecraft; those edge IDs identify the architecture exposed to the integration gate.

items.title: #3 · Two wave active secure cloud reach
items.sub: 2 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade A
items.text: An AWS authorization restriction, operating-service interruption, task reduction, or failed IL5, IL6 or OCONUS acceptance affects secure workloads.
kv: ATO restriction or revocation; official service-incident notice; DWWCF scope or budget reduction; JWCC task modification or rejected workload transition
Secret or Restricted Data scientific workloads and DoW Olympus or Joint Operational Edge workloads could lose a common provider path.
Program-specific Microsoft, Oracle, HPE or on-premises paths and workload portability may provide redundancy after authorization and migration gates.
AI, secure compute and platform; Information management and cybersecurity
What the record does not prove

The two AWS relationships are direct but distinct environments and instruments; an incident in one is not proof that the other is impaired, and alternative vendors are not automatically authorized or workload-compatible.

items.title: #4 · Two wave launch and network reach
items.sub: 2 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: A SpaceX launch anomaly or stand-down, assigned-mission delay, or failed Space Data Network prototype milestone occurs.
kv: FAA mishap investigation or launch stand-down; SSC task reassignment; missed assigned launch date; SDN end-to-end acceptance milestone change
SDA or NSSL payload deployment and the separate SDN prototype-delivery clock could both slip.
ULA, Blue Origin and Rocket Lab provide mission-specific alternatives, while other communications architectures may reduce SDN dependence; none is automatically interchangeable.
Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing; Communications and networking
What the record does not prove

Both company paths are direct, but the registries do not establish shared vehicles, launch sites or schedules between the assigned launch missions and SDN; one program delay does not prove the other is delayed.

items.title: #5 · Four sector component reach
items.sub: 4 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: Domestic rare-earth magnet blocks fail DLA or customer qualification, arrive late, or fail to reach recurring accepted output.
kv: DLA lot rejection or late delivery; option not exercised; missing certificate or origin record; customer qualification or recurring-shipment delay
Domestic-source constraints could affect motors, guidance, beam-control positioning, tactical terminals and aerospace mechanisms.
Three domestic magnet paths, inventory, design substitution and alternate motor topologies provide partial redundancy after platform qualification.
Critical materials and component supply chains; Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing; Directed energy; Communications and networking
What the record does not prove

DLA orders and magnet capacity paths are direct, but no registry source assigns MP, Noveon or eVAC magnets to the named hypersonic, laser or SATCOM edges; downstream edge IDs are representative exposure markers only.

items.title: #6 · Three sector scientific compute reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: The Argonne frontier-AI center's final agreement, financing, power, cooling or accepted-capacity milestone slips.
kv: final center instrument remains unsigned; financing structure remains unresolved; power or liquid-cooling readiness slip; accepted capacity is below announced scope
Scientific-model, materials-simulation and autonomous-laboratory workloads may be deferred or shifted even if accelerators and software are available.
Other DOE systems, LANL Mission and Vision, Lux and Discovery, and authorized cloud capacity may absorb selected workloads after portability and security checks.
AI, secure compute and platform; Semiconductors and microelectronics; Autonomous laboratories and scientific infrastructure
What the record does not prove
The center and compute partnerships are direct; no source proves every Genesis or autonomous-lab workload is assigned to Argonne or that alternate systems have spare authorized capacity.

items.title: #7 · Three sector autonomous lab reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy medium-high · evidence grade B
items.text: AMP2, M2PC or another autonomous-laboratory testbed is delayed, fails equipment integration, or does not produce an accepted closed-loop workflow.
kv: construction or commissioning delay; selected bill of material remains unpublished; equipment order or integration subcontract is absent; closed-loop experiment metrics fail acceptance
Shared experimental capacity, closed-loop biological or materials discovery, and structured data generation could slow.
Multiple national-lab testbeds, manual workflows and distributed commercial laboratories provide partial redundancy.
Autonomous laboratories and scientific infrastructure; Biotechnology and biomanufacturing; AI, secure compute and platform
What the record does not prove

Ginkgo's AMP2 role is direct; Periodic, Chemspeed and Universal Robots do not yet have confirmed orders for the new testbeds, and a facility delay does not prove Ginkgo's separate DARPA or surveillance paths fail.

items.title: #8 · Two sector commercial relay reach
items.sub: 2 sectors · immediacy medium-high · evidence grade B
items.text: A NASA commercial-relay demonstration fails, a constellation or terminal slips, or NASA does not transition the demonstrations to recurring procurement.
kv: planned 2027 end-to-end demonstration slips; terminal or constellation readiness delay; service-qualification failure; no recurring operational solicitation or task order
Civil-space missions expecting commercial relay may retain legacy relay or direct-to-Earth dependencies or delay operating concepts.
Multiple CSP providers, the Near Space Network and legacy or direct links offer partial mission-specific redundancy.
Communications and networking; Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing
What the record does not prove

The demonstration relationships are direct, but no registry source assigns a particular W3 mission to these services; a funded Space Act Agreement or successful PExT test is not recurring operational service.

items.title: #9 · Three sector memory packaging reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy medium · evidence grade B
items.text: A domestic HBM or advanced-packaging project suffers construction, tool-installation, commissioning or accelerator-qualification delay.
kv: CHIPS construction or milestone-payment delay; tool installation or commissioning slip; customer qualification remains unnamed; no qualified U.S. HBM production date
Conversion to domestically fabricated or packaged HBM and accelerators for scientific and secure AI could slow.
Intel packaging and foreign or legacy supply chains may provide capacity, subject to origin, security and customer-qualification requirements.
Semiconductors and microelectronics; AI, secure compute and platform; Information management and cybersecurity
What the record does not prove
CHIPS awards and facilities are direct; announced nameplate is not output, and no registry source assigns these facilities to NVIDIA, AMD, OpenAI or Google workloads.

items.title: #10 · Three sector pnt infrastructure reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: GPS IIIF delivery, launch, on-orbit checkout or acceptance fails or slips.
kv: GPS IIIF delivery slip; launch reassignment or anomaly; failed on-orbit test; acceptance or constellation-transition delay
Communications and precision mission systems could remain dependent on the older GPS constellation longer than planned.
Atomic-clock, magnetic-navigation and inertial paths can add resilience after quantitative validation and program integration.
Quantum information, sensing and resilient PNT; Communications and networking; Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing
What the record does not prove

The GPS successor transition is direct; magnetic navigation and atomic-clock paths are not drop-in replacements for GPS, are not broadly accepted operational substitutes, and their edge IDs mark mitigation candidates rather than confirmed dependencies.

items.title: #11 · Three sector ir optics reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: Germanium refining equipment is delayed, refined material misses purity requirements, or domestic germanium or silicon optics fail component acceptance.
kv: equipment commissioning delay; certificate-of-analysis or purity failure; accepted component record absent; recurring qualified shipment absent
Domestic IR detector and optic availability for sensing, tracking and laser-related systems could remain constrained.
Recycling, inventory and alternate optical materials or designs provide partial redundancy after system qualification.
Critical materials and component supply chains; Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing; Directed energy
What the record does not prove

The material and optics capacity investments are direct, but the registry does not establish a 5N-to-Lattice supply contract or assignment to a named W3 or W4 platform; downstream edges are representative exposure markers.

items.title: #12 · Two wave hpe integration reach
items.sub: 2 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: An HPE integration or support failure occurs, or the DISA Cloud Instance signatory and first deployment milestone cannot be resolved and executed.
kv: executed DCI OTA still does not name the legal entity; first accepted DCI deployment milestone slips; Mission or Vision integration milestone slips; support or acceptance defect recurs across programs
DOE exascale or AI integration and sovereign distributed private-cloud deployment could slip in parallel.
Program-specific alternate integrators, public-cloud paths and existing on-premises systems may provide redundancy after integration and authorization.
AI, secure compute and platform; Information management and cybersecurity
What the record does not prove

The W1 HPE Company path is direct; the W4 exact legal counterparty remains unresolved and cannot be consolidated as CONFIRMED, and no source proves that the same business unit, workforce or facility supports both paths.

items.title: #13 · Two wave ginkgo platform reach
items.sub: 2 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade A
items.text: Ginkgo's autonomous-platform commissioning, DARPA RPM independent validation, or current genomic-surveillance contract path fails or lapses.
kv: AMP2 construction or commissioning slip; RPM independent metric failure; no named operational transition customer; current CDC, BARDA or diagnostic-network contract absent
Autonomous experimental capacity, protein-manufacturing validation and genomic-surveillance continuity could each lose a named company path.
Other DARPA performers, federal laboratories and independent surveillance networks provide program-specific alternatives.
Autonomous laboratories and scientific infrastructure; Biotechnology and biomanufacturing
What the record does not prove
All three relationships are direct, but a failure in one Ginkgo program does not establish failure, cross-default or shared-facility impairment in the others.

items.title: #14 · Two sector quantum fabrication reach
items.sub: 2 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: Quantum CHIPS letters of intent expire or fail to become definitive agreements, named sites and qualified fabrication or packaging output.
kv: LOI expiration or scope change; recipient legal entity or site remains unresolved; definitive agreement is not executed; wafer or package qualification fails
Domestic quantum fabrication and packaging redundancy would remain unbuilt, leaving quantum-system programs on existing supply paths.
Multiple LOI recipients and existing foundry or pilot routes provide partial redundancy, subject to qubit-specific process compatibility.
Quantum information, sensing and resilient PNT; Semiconductors and microelectronics
What the record does not prove
The LOIs are direct but are not final awards; failure to convert a LOI does not automatically terminate QBI or US2QC participation, and no qualified output is yet established.

items.title: #15 · Three sector nde qualification reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: A QTIME rapid inspection system fails speed, repeatability or transition acceptance.
kv: inspection system misses speed or repeatability metric; acceptance record is absent; no transition to DoD, FAA or NASA production; audit or process-control failure
Additive-part qualification could remain slower for flight and weapon-system production.
Conventional NDE and multiple project teams provide slower but potentially usable alternatives.
Advanced manufacturing and industrial qualification; Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing; Directed energy
What the record does not prove

QTIME performer selection is direct, but no source ties QTIME to a specific hypersonic, satellite or directed-energy production line; downstream edge IDs are representative qualification exposure only.

items.title: #16 · Three sector exact company reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: A firm-wide Booz Allen eligibility, suspension or capacity event affects multiple exact-entity contracts; a single program test failure is not sufficient.
kv: SAM exclusion or eligibility action; Thunderdome option not exercised; Navy wireless contract not definitized or accepted; HPM follow-on recompete loss
DoDNet migration, Navy wireless installation and HPM test support could each lose the same exact contractor path.
Program-specific recompetes and alternate integrators or test contractors provide separate replacement paths.
Information management and cybersecurity; Communications and networking; Directed energy
What the record does not prove
The three Booz Allen Hamilton Inc. relationships are direct, but shared staffing, infrastructure and cross-default terms are not established; one edge does not prove impairment of the others.

items.title: #17 · Three sector parent family reach
items.sub: 3 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade C
items.text: A parent-wide Lockheed eligibility or common-component disruption affects multiple programs; a program-specific laser failure alone is not sufficient.
kv: parent-wide eligibility or supply action; GPS IIIF delivery slip; LRHW or interceptor test failure; JLWS or IFPC acceptance failure; HELIOS operational-test or replication failure
PNT spacecraft, hypersonic or interceptor work and directed-energy prototypes could slip only under a genuinely parent-wide common-cause event.
Program-specific competitors and separate business or legal entities limit some common-cause exposure.
Quantum information, sensing and resilient PNT; Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing; Directed energy
What the record does not prove

Individual relationships are direct, but Lockheed Martin Corporation and Lockheed Martin Aculight Corp. are separate canonical legal entities; IFPC trouble does not prove GPS, hypersonic or HELIOS trouble.

items.title: #18 · Two sector launch acquisition reach
items.sub: 2 sectors · immediacy high · evidence grade B
items.text: An NSSL Phase 3 task is canceled or reassigned, a provider loses certification, or the vehicle is materially restructured.
kv: mission assignment or task modification; certification loss or anomaly closure delay; launch task cancellation or reassignment; payload acceptance schedule slip
Scheduled national-security and missile-tracking payload deployment could slip even when spacecraft production is complete.
Three Lane 2 providers plus mission-specific small-launch paths provide bounded redundancy after certification and payload-interface review.
Space, hypersonics and advanced sensing; Communications and networking
What the record does not prove

A requirements contract does not guarantee mission assignment, one provider's task cannot automatically transfer to another, Rocket Lab is a separate OSP-4 path, and no source assigns SDN to the affected NSSL tasks.
